environment.nothingSaved: No organisation created, edited or deleted; every form left with Cancel; list identical before and after (reload).

sideFindings: Edit form of an organisation with no pool (e.g. "test 001"): the label reads "Prompt pool" without the " *" required marker (shown on Create and on organisations with a saved pool). Possibly the remaining case of GEO-1274.

Same form: after changing another field (User quota) with Prompt pool still empty, Save becomes enabled and no "Prompt pool is required." message is shown — an organisation without a pool can be saved without setting one (client side; server answer not observed). To confirm with the PO whether this is intended for legacy organisations.
Below-usage warning is shown inline as soon as the value is lower than usage (not on save) and replaces the usage hint (role="alert", red).
Invalid or empty Prompt pool: the message is red but the input border stays grey.
Dialog titles use different case: "Create organisation" vs "Edit Organisation — {name}" (capital O).
Frequency filter options are lower case ("all frequencies", "daily", "one time") while the column shows "Daily" / "One time"; Status filter options also lower case.
Prompts sort header has no aria-sort attribute; only the button colour changes.
GEO-1272 (sort mixes "—" rows) did not reproduce: "—" rows grouped at the end in both directions.
csvProposals: TC-GEO-1230-007 step 3: move the warning to step 2 — "When the super admin lowers the pool below usage" → expected "The hint turns into a warning: \"U of U - 10 prompts in use. Existing prompts and running analyses are untouched; adding prompts is blocked until the count fits.\"", and step 3 "And the super admin saves" → "The Save button is enabled".
TC-GEO-1230-003 step 3: "And the super admin saves" → expected "The Create button stays disabled and the organisation is not created" (Create is disabled while Prompt pool is empty).

TC-GEO-1230-004/005: quote the exact strings — hint "U of P prompts in use.", error "Enter a whole number of at least 1.", empty "Prompt pool is required."; step 5 of TC-005: "The value cannot be entered (the field stays empty)".
TC-GEO-1230-006: add the expected label of organisation N ("Prompt pool *" or "Prompt pool") and whether Save is allowed with an empty pool — PO decision needed (see side finding).
TC-GEO-1230-010 and TC-007 step 4: add a Precondition on setup data (organisation at its pool, organisation above it) since staging has none and creating them needs back-office saves.

results.title: Create organisation shows one required Prompt pool field in place of the old quotas
results.description: Verify that the Create organisation form shows one "Prompt pool" field, marked as required, replacing the four per-type fields and the "Countries" and "Categories max" fields, while the user quota, collection frequency (Daily or One time) and allowed AI engines stay as today. Covers AC-1. Known open bug GEO-1274: the required Prompt pool field has no asterisk.

steps.observed: Administration > Users & Organisations > Organisations: 8 active organisations listed

results.notes: Form closed with Cancel, nothing saved. GEO-1274 (missing asterisk) not reproduced on the Create form; see side finding about the Edit form of an organisation with no pool.

results.title: An organisation cannot be created without a Prompt pool
results.description: Verify that the Prompt pool is required when creating an organisation: saving with an empty Prompt pool is refused. Covers AC-1 (required rule). Known open bug GEO-1274: the required Prompt pool field has no asterisk.

steps.title: Given the super admin is on the Create organisation form
steps.expected: The form is displayed with an empty "Prompt pool" field
steps.observed: Create organisation form open, Prompt pool empty

steps.title: When the super admin fills every other required field and leaves Prompt pool empty
steps.testData: Name: "QA pool required 1019"; User quota: 5; Frequency: Daily; one AI engine
steps.expected: The form is filled except Prompt pool
steps.observed: Name "QA pool required 1019", User quota 5, Frequency Daily, ChatGPT ON; Prompt pool left empty

steps.title: And the super admin saves
steps.expected: The organisation is not created
steps.observed: "Create" stays disabled while Prompt pool is empty; a forced click sends no request (guard log empty) and the dialog stays open → the organisation is not created

steps.title: Then the Prompt pool field is flagged as required
steps.expected: An error is shown on the "Prompt pool" field and the field carries the required marker
steps.observed: Red message "Prompt pool is required." (role="alert", text-red-600) under the field, aria-invalid="true", label "Prompt pool *"

results.notes: Client-side validation blocks the creation: no write request was sent (0 request caught by the guard). Side note: the field border itself does not turn red (only the message is red). Closed with Cancel.

results.title: Lowering the pool below usage warns and still saves
results.description: Verify that saving a pool lower than the prompts in use shows a warning that existing prompts and running analyses are untouched and that adding prompts stays blocked until the count fits, without blocking the save. Covers AC-3. Needs setup: organisation T with U > 10 prompts in use; restore the pool afterwards.
results.error: Step 4 (save not blocked, list shows "713 / 703" in red) not executed: save not allowed, user decision.

steps.observed: Edit QA-GEO: hint "713 of 1000 prompts in use."

steps.expected: The hint reads "U of U - 10 prompts in use."
steps.observed: Prompt pool 703 (U - 10): hint reads "713 of 703 prompts in use. ..." (the hint turns into the red warning, role="alert")

steps.title: And the super admin saves
steps.expected: A warning states that existing prompts and running analyses are untouched and that adding prompts stays blocked until the count fits
steps.observed: Warning shown before saving: "713 of 703 prompts in use. Existing prompts and running analyses are untouched; adding prompts is blocked until the count fits." Save stays enabled (not blocked client-side)

results.title: The Prompts column of the organisations list is sortable
results.description: Verify that the "Prompts" column of the organisations list can be sorted, organisations being ordered by their prompts in use, with the organisations without a pool ("—") not interleaved between the others. Covers AC-4. Known open bug GEO-1272: sorting by Prompts mixes the organisations with no pool between the others.

steps.observed: "Prompts" header is a sort button (data-testid backoffice-organisations-sort-prompts)

steps.expected: The organisations are ordered by prompts in use, lowest first

steps.title: And the super admin sorts the Prompts column descending
steps.expected: The organisations are ordered by prompts in use, highest first
steps.observed: Descending: 713 / 1000, 471 / 1000, 246 / 250, then the 5 "—" rows

steps.title: Then the organisations without a pool are not mixed between the others
steps.expected: Every "—" row is grouped together, never between two organisations with a value
steps.observed: The "—" rows stay grouped at the end in both directions, never between two valued rows

results.notes: Known bug GEO-1272 did NOT reproduce (8 active organisations, one page). Order follows prompts in use (not the ratio). A 3rd click returns to the unsorted default order (Created at desc), where "—" rows are naturally mixed. No aria-sort attribute on the header (only the button colour changes). Server-side sort across pages not checked (1 page in the active view).
